request:
Feature request: staff sometimes book a visit for the wrong pet or the wrong
day. Add cancelling: the owner detail page offers a cancel action beside each
upcoming visit, and cancelling removes that visit from the pet's record.
Cover the new behavior with tests.

author: product-requirements-expert
context: Scoping the intake-decision at handoff line 1 into a prd-entry. The request asks for a cancel action beside each upcoming visit on the owner detail page, removing the visit from the pet's record. That is barred twice by the recorded boundary, by the explicit text of both rows rather than by implication. NG-5 declines 'Changing or cancelling a visit once booked'. NG-4 declines 'Deleting an owner, a pet, or a visit'. Both were confirmed deliberate on 2026-08-08 by docs/adr/2026-08-08-non-goal-deletion-and-visit-amendment.md, which states: 'A future request touching either row proceeds only on an explicit owner decision recorded at intake. The request itself never reopens the row.' The intake-decision records an empty decisions list, so no owner decision on NG-4 or NG-5 exists. I will not treat the request as the override. One further gap: the request says 'upcoming visit', and no recorded term distinguishes upcoming from past visits. REQ-VIS-001 refuses a booking dated today or earlier, but the owner detail page under REQ-OWN-003 shows every visit a pet has made, so both kinds appear side by side. 'Cancel' and 'upcoming visit' are also absent from docs/ubiquitous-language.md.
question: Three options. (A) Hold the boundary: NG-4 and NG-5 stand as confirmed on 2026-08-08, and this request is declined. I record no requirement, append no prd-entry, and add one line to the existing non-goal ADR noting the request was raised and declined. This is my recommendation, because the ADR is seven days old, decided this exact case in advance, and its rationale is unchanged by a request that restates the capability it declined. (B) Narrow the boundary to cancellation only: staff may cancel a visit dated later than today, and every other amendment stays out. On this answer I rewrite the NG-5 row to decline changing a booked visit while permitting cancellation, narrow the NG-4 row to exclude visit cancellation, add a new REQ under Visits with acceptance criteria for the cancel action and for a visit that no longer appears on the owner record, add 'cancel' and 'upcoming visit' to docs/ubiquitous-language.md, write a new non-goal ADR superseding the 2026-08-08 one, and quote your decision verbatim in the prd-entry's scope_overrides for NG-4 and NG-5. (C) Open the rows fully: cancelling and changing a booked visit both become in scope, which retires NG-5 and narrows NG-4; I would scope only cancellation in this slice and record the rest as a further REQ. To choose B or C, state the decision in words I can quote verbatim, including whether cancellation is confined to visits dated later than today or reaches past visits too, and whether a cancelled visit disappears from the record or is retained and marked.
stop_state: docs/prd.md unchanged; no prd-entry appended; awaiting the owner decision on NG-4 and NG-5 before drafting the Visits requirement.
